subject: tf-sh
title: TF.SH.------CULT.INFO.F.
description: Chart on book p. 352 (PMBA-16). TF-SH (transfer shifts) is the subject; CULT-INFO-F (culture information focus) is the partner. From the subject: PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics), MT-INFO (multi-information) and C-CONT (composite continuance). From PROJ-DY: BIA (bi-aitional) and ATTN (attraction). From ATTN: IF-SPT (infra-spirituality). From MT-INFO: LK-IMP (linkage implications) and IF-ST-DY (infra-structure dynamics). From C-CONT: ALT-FT (alternative functionalism). From ALT-FT: GRAD (gradualism). From GRAD: LANG-DY (language dynamics). A line from the IF-ST-DY line ends in a dot with no label.
